desc:
Crazy Ragdoll Playground is a physics ragdoll sandbox where every hit counts: dummies stagger, limp and crawl, and the x-ray shows their bones cracking.

🆕 New: weapons you unlock now land right in your hands, and free gifts open as you play.

🎯 Nearly 100 weapons, gadgets, traps and wild syringes to unlock
🦖 Summon animals from wolves to a T-Rex, ride them or turn into one
🏗️ Built-in machines: piano and anvil drops, a hydraulic press, a shredder and a shark tank
💥 Smash glass, crates and walls, fire dummies from the cannon or send them down the stair tower
🚜 Drive the quad bike and the tank, and tow dummies along with a lasso
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Dummies have friends: they chat, stand up for each other and drag the fallen to safety
🥊 Step into the boxing ring and take on the boxers
🏆 Daily rewards, quests, achievements and global leaderboards

🎮 Play on PC, phone, tablet, console and VR, with full controller support.
